SnowDistribution: Winds approx 40-50 mph making progress very difficult. Fresh snow on heather made for very tiring conditions Blizzard and whiteout conditions presenting challenging and serious conditions.
Comment: Some snow redistribution is expected during the day as winds veer to the South-South-West.
WeatherInfluences: Storm force South-South-East winds will continue overnight then veer South-South-West and ease to become fresh during the day. There will be persistent snow overnight then mostly dry during the day. A complex freezing level with much terrain remaining frozen above 500 metres.
SnowStability: Further unstable windslab will develop on North-West to North-East aspects above 950 metres. West and East aspects will also be affected due to cross-loading. The greatest instability will be in steep locations such as gullies, gully tops, coire rims and convexities. On these aspects, cornices will be fragile. Below this altitude and above 700 metres isolated deposits of windslab will be present in wind sheltered locations. The avalanche hazard will be Considerable.
ObservedWeatherInfluences: It was dry throughout the period with storm force South-South-East winds. The freezing level was around 800 meters.
ObservedSnowStability: Unstable windslab is lying on West through North to North-East aspects above 950 metres. The greatest instabilities are in steep wind sheltered locations such as gullies, gully tops, coire rims and convexities. Cornices are fragile and prone to collapse. Below 950 metres and above 700 metres the snow cover is thin with isolated deposits of firm moderately bonded windslab. The avalanche hazard is Considerable.
